subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 11: Get ready for… A2 Key for Schools
outcomes: Read a text and choose the correct answer, then check the other options are wrong.
Fill a gap with ONE correct word by thinking about the type of word.

tf.s: After you choose an answer, it is a good idea to check the other options are wrong.
tf.why: Yes, this is the exam tip for Reading Part 3.

tf.s: Thuriya has been a writer for twenty years.
tf.why: Yes, she has been a writer for a long time.

tf.s: Thuriya travelled to Antarctica a month ago.
tf.why: She has been there for three weeks.

tf.s: Thuriya is going to Africa next.
tf.why: Yes, and it will be warmer there.

tf.s: In a one-word gap task, you can write two or three words.
tf.why: You write only ONE word in each gap.

tf.s: It is helpful to read the whole text first before filling the gaps.
tf.why: Yes, it helps you understand and predict.

tf.s: Only a few children read Wild Kids magazine.
tf.why: Thousands of children all around the world read it.
She cooks twice a week, on Monday and Friday.

tf.s: A good tip for Reading Part 1 is to think where you might see each text.
tf.why: Yes, that helps you understand a notice.

tf.s: Twice a week means two times every week.

boxes.q: How long has Thuriya been a writer?
boxes.why: She has been a writer for twenty years.

boxes.q: How often does Thuriya cook dinner?
boxes.why: She cooks on Monday and Friday.
Her next trip is to Africa.
Use since with a point in time.

boxes.q: Complete: If it rains, we ___ stay at home.
boxes.why: First conditional: If + present, will + verb.

boxes.q: A notice says: Closed on Friday. Where might you see it?
boxes.why: Shops put notices like this on the door.

boxes.q: Complete: A seal has ___ instead of feet.
Where might you see a notice about devices in boxes?
boxes.why: Airports ask you to put devices in boxes.
Children all around the world read it.

boxes.q: What should you check after filling a gap?

mcq.q: What is the exam tip for Reading Part 3?
o: After choosing, check the other two options are wrong.
mcq.why: Checking wrong options makes you sure.

mcq.q: Why will Thuriya be happier in Africa?
o: Because she can cook every day.
mcq.why: Antarctica is very cold; Africa is warmer.

mcq.q: What type of word is missing? The camel has a big ___ on its back.
mcq.why: The missing word is a thing: hump.

mcq.q: Which is an exam tip for one-word gaps?
o: Read the sentence before and after the gap.
Write as many words as you like.
mcq.why: The sentences around the gap help you.

mcq.q: Circus notice: Half-price tickets on Monday. Tickets are usually 10 rials. How much is a ticket on Monday?
Airport notice: Put devices in the boxes. You don't have to take off your shoes. Which is true?
o: You can keep your shoes on.
You must take off your shoes.
mcq.why: Don't have to means it is not necessary.

mcq.q: Choose the ONE word: He has worked here ___ ten years.
mcq.why: Use for with a length of time.

mcq.q: Thuriya has been in Antarctica for three weeks. Why is 'A month ago' wrong for when she travelled there?
o: Three weeks is less than a month.
She went there a year ago.
A month is shorter than three weeks.
mcq.why: She arrived three weeks ago, not a month ago.

mcq.q: Why is it important to read the whole text before filling the gaps?
o: To understand the general meaning and predict words.
To finish the test faster without thinking.
To count the number of lines.
mcq.why: Knowing the meaning helps you guess the gap.

mcq.q: It ___ be a bird. It doesn't have wings. Why is can't correct?
o: We are sure it is not a bird.
We think it might be a bird.
We are sure it is a bird.
We are talking about the past.
mcq.why: Can't shows we are sure something is impossible.
